## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juan* Northern-Sòng compiled-interpretations commentary by **Cóngyì** 從義 (1042–1091) on Dìguān's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* ([KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168), T1931). The work is the principal Sòng-period subcommentary on the standard Tiāntái introductory manual, and through its transmission the standard medieval pedagogical apparatus for the *Sìjiào yí*.

**Abstract**

Cóngyì's *Jíjiě* draws together the various interpretations of Dìguān's *Sìjiào yí* current in the mid-Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* tradition, providing systematic commentary on each section of the manual. The work belongs together with Cóngyì's other major Sòng productions ([KR6d0063](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0063), [KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139), [KR6d0140](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0140)) as the principal mid-Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* scholastic apparatus.

The composition is bracketed within Cóngyì's productive period c. 1062–1091.
